title: Europa daughter of Philip
summary: Raleigh names Europa daughter of Philip in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Europa, Daughter of Philip by Cleopatra the Neece of Attalus, whom Olympias murdered at the Mothers brest. The one-word title would not say which, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter I, §. IX, sig. 465a
